name: Question 9
problem: The volume $V$ (in cubic centimeters) of water in a pail $s$ seconds after it starts filling can be modeled by the function $V(s)=7\sqrt{s}+2.$ Find the instantaneous rate at which the volume of water is changing with respect to time at the moment when the volume of water in the pail is equal to $30$ cubic centimeters.

Find the instantaneous rate at which the volume of water is changing with respect to time at the moment when the volume of water in the pail is equal to 30 cubic centimeters.

1116 cubic centimeters per second
b
73060 cubic centimeters per second

716 cubic centimeters per second

78 cubic centimeters per second
